SELECT
	Doctype = 'SV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SALEINVCODE, 10))), 
	PatientCode=SL.PatientCode,
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	PatientName = P.Name,
	Refno1 = P.RefNo1,
	Refno2 = P.RefNo2,
	Refno3 = P.RefNo3,
	Refno4 = P.RefNo4,
	Refno5 = P.RefNo5,
	Refno6 = P.RefNo6,
	Refno7 = P.RefNo7,
	CustCode = SL.CustCode,
	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	Customer = A.Name,
	Type = 'S',
	InvCode = SL.SaleInvCode,
	Date = SL.Date,
	SaleTypeCode = SL.SaleTypeCode,
	ItemAlias = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Qty = SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	SalePrice = SD.SalePrice, 
	Discount = SUM( (SD.LooseQty * SD.ItemFlatDisc) + 
		(SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) + 
		((SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)))),
	Value = SUM((SD.LooseQty * (SD.SalePrice - SD.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)))
FROM
	Patient P,
	SaleLedger SL,
	SaleDetail SD,
	Accounts A,
	Item I
WHERE
	P.PatientCode IN (:ai_patientcode) AND
	P.PatientCode = SL.PatientCode AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate AND
	SL.SaleTypeCode IN (:ai_saletypecode) AND
	SL.SaleInvCode = SD.SaleInvCode AND
	SL.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode
GROUP BY
	SL.PatientCode,
	P.RegNo,
	P.Name,
	P.RefNo1,
	P.RefNo2,
	P.RefNo3,
	P.RefNo4,
	P.RefNo5,
	P.RefNo6,
	P.RefNo7,
	SL.CustCode,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name,
	SL.SaleInvCode,
	SL.Date,
	SL.SaleTypeCode,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,
	SD.SalePrice
UNION ALL

SELECT
	Doctype = 'SR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(SL.SRINVCODE, 10))), 
	PatientCode=SL.PatientCode,
	RegNo = P.RegNo,
	PatientName = P.Name,
	Refno1 = P.RefNo1,
	Refno2 = P.RefNo2,
	Refno3 = P.RefNo3,
	Refno4 = P.RefNo4,
	Refno5 = P.RefNo5,
	Refno6 = P.RefNo6,

	AliasName = A.AliasName,
	Customer = A.Name,
	Type = 'R',
	InvCode = SL.SRInvCode,
	Date = SL.Date,
	SaleTypeCode = NULL,
	ItemAlias = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	Qty = - SUM(SD.LooseQty),
	SalePrice = SD.SRPrice,
	Discount = - SUM( (SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) + 
		((SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)))),
	Value = - SUM((SD.LooseQty * SD.SRPrice * (1 - SD.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - SL.DiscPerc * 0.01)))
FROM
	Patient P,
	SRLedger SL,
	SRDetail SD,
	Accounts A,
	Item I
WHERE
	P.PatientCode IN (:ai_patientcode) AND
	P.PatientCode = SL.PatientCode AND
	SL.Date BETWEEN :adt_StartDate AND :adt_EndDate AND
	SL.SRInvCode = SD.SRInvCode AND
	SL.CustCode = A.AccCode AND
	SD.ICode = I.ICode

	SL.SRInvCode,
	SL.Date,
	I.CustomICode,
	I.Name,

	PatientName,
	Date,
	InvCode,
	ItemName
